Eighteen-year-old Monish is a skateboarder from Chennai, India, with ambitions of becoming a model and fashion icon. Photographer Raajadharshini captured his distinctive personal style as part of her ongoing work documenting Chennai’s youth and the creative communities emerging around sports, fashion, music, and the arts. Through her work, she hopes to bring wider attention to subcultures in Chennai and across Tamil Nadu that are often overlooked outside the region.
